caveats: Region grid cells: 60x60 on the 0.02 deg product grid; 3287 sea cells had finite SST on all 92 target days, the other 313 land/masked cells are set to 0. Thresholds/climatology per day of year (1..366, 29 Feb=60, no day 60 in non-leap years) from baseline 1992-2002 pools of all SST within +/-5 calendar days of baseline dates with that day of year, including the 5-day extensions beyond the baseline ends (1991-12-27..1991-12-31 and 2003-01-01..2003-01-05); all pools had exactly 121 values. Threshold = 90th percentile (numpy method='hazen', Hyndman-Fan type 5) and climatology = mean, NaN ignored; day 60 set to the mean of days 59 and 61; each then smoothed with an unweighted centred 31-day moving mean wrapping the 366-day year. Hot day: SST (K) >= threshold. Per-cell MHW: >=5 consecutive hot days; MHWs separated by 1-2 non-hot days joined with gap days included. One regional event detected: 2003-07-15 to 2003-08-08 (all 3287 sea cells were inside a per-cell MHW on 2003-07-27 through 2003-08-05).
